top_signals.title: DHL's Venter: Supply Chain Resilience Is Key to Growth
top_signals.summary:
DHL Supply Chain CEO Hendrik Venter says resilience is becoming a strategic advantage, as tariffs and geopolitical disruptions make global supply chains more complex. He says first-time outsourcing accounted for more than 40 percent of DHL’s 12 percent year-on-year growth in the third quarter. He speaks with Paul Allen on "Insight with Haslinda Amin."

 (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.summary: Crude oil prices bounced back in early Asian trade on Thursday, climbing higher after fresh reports of tankers hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz and the latest Yemeni Houthi attack on Saudi Arabia, which targeted a refinery. At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $95.30 per barrel, with West Texas Intermediate at $84.36 per barrel. The rise follows several days of losses as traders focused on predictions of a supply overhang, ignoring the mine strike reports.
